ability_acquisition.COPY: On success, Jack stores the ability and the target retains it.
ability_acquisition.REMOVE: On success, Jack stores the ability and the target permanently loses it.
ability_acquisition.failure: No acquisition occurs; failure consequences and CM debit use the active balance file.
ability_acquisition.requirement: direct physical contact with the living bearer

cm_cost_rule.principle: Ability acquisition cost = fixed CM-use component + ability-level component.

hp_theft.death_rule: If target HP reaches 0 from Steal, the target dies.
hp_theft.target_deterioration: Visible physical deterioration must track vitality loss.

resistance.full_restraint_or_broken_will: Effective resistance is reduced. If the target is both fully restrained and Will-broken, the active balance resolver may treat resistance as overcome.

stat_theft.corpse_rule: After target HP reaches 0 and the target dies, other stealable stats become unavailable/0 to the Steal interface.
stat_theft.permanence: The target permanently loses every successfully stolen stat point or resource unit.
